intent: Omit repository-relative filenames from default diagnostic capture of retained GitHub checkpoints and tool results while preserving structural evidence and the separately selected forensic mode.
observedRoutes: GitHubReviewSourceQueue selected_paths and GitHubReviewComparison pending_source_paths reach persisted checklist and verification objects hydrated into staged latest_state.
Repository preparation and path resolution retain deferred_files[].path, path, filename, previous_filename and path_prefix in structured tool results and JSON checkpoint displays.
acceptance: Apply the central policy to actual structured path fields and nested JSON before staged snapshot, chunking, hashing and checkpointing; use fictional repository-relative paths in regressions.
Retain object and array containers, booleans, numeric counters, typed states and codes, source hashes and schema definitions; omit string path leaves.
Preserve credential redaction in both modes, explicit forensic content selection and redaction idempotence.
Preserve all preceding shared commits and compose the independently owned detail, producer-schema, authorization and trusted-protocol corrections before final qualification.
Require the final integrated source to pass applicable hosted Android and staged-export checks; focused helper tests do not substitute for those gates.
Respect predecessor publication sequencing, reconcile unused Android and Gateway versions, and qualify the actual merged main and both published packages.
limits: The exact-key correction covers the evidenced structured path values; it does not claim to remove arbitrary unlabelled paths embedded in prose.
